neighbours.label: Digits of the year in the name of a law or act ('the Modern Slavery Act 2015', 'the Data Protection Act 1998'); years used in ordinary dates stay quiet.
fire: The rules come from the Data Protection Act 1998.
Charities must follow the Equality Act 2010.
The case was brought under the Human Rights Act 1998.
Firms report under the Modern Slavery Act 2015.
Landlords must comply with the Housing Act 2004.
The Climate Change Act 2008 set new targets.
Schools are bound by the Children Act 1989.
Fines are set by the Bribery Act 2010.
quiet: The rules changed in 1998 after the election.
The case was heard in 1998 in London.
The landlord bought the house in 2004.

short: year digits in the name of an Act
notes: Card: '3' x4, '0' x3, '.' x3, ' psychiatrist' (within the Modern Slavery Act 2⟦0⟧15); output promotes ' shift'. Exploratory probe: 'Modern Slavery Act 2015' 0.96; 'psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter' 0.36. Ordinary dates not probed.
